item.description: Minneapolis offers a warning for law enforcement leaders as political conflict undermines coordination and officer safety

item.title: Shots Fired: Federal agents shooting Alex Pretti in Minneapolis
item.description: How crowd dynamics, officer training and real-time decisions shaped the narrative before the investigation began

item.title: Chicago mayor orders PD to investigate alleged federal LE misconduct incidents
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson's order instructs the Chicago PD to preserve BWC footage, identify federal supervisors at the scene and complete reports in cases of alleged misconduct

item.title: LAPD homicide clearance rate rose to nearly 70% in 2025
item.description: Of the 230 homicides logged, officials said that 156, or 68%, were considered solved; factoring in the 78 killings from past years that were solved in 2025, the rate rose to 101%

item.title: BWC: Ohio man crashes motorcycle after pursuit, grabs gun before fatal OIS
item.description: Video shows the suspect fleeing into the woods after a fiery crash and brandishing a weapon before being shot by Ohio officers

item.title: NYPD officer charged in cooler throw death testifies he was trying to protect colleagues
item.description: “He was gonna crash into us,” Eric Duran told the court. "... All I had time for was to try again to stop or to try to get him to change directions. That’s all I had the time to think of.”

item.title: BWC: Wash. deputy deploys spike strips, stopping driver fleeing at more than 150 mph
item.description: Upon spotting a Thurston County deputy and K-9 unit, the suspect took off their plates before doing donuts and fleeing at high speeds
